papers.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6\% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2\% and 42.9\% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人操作领域目前依赖针对特定任务、基于示教训练的专业策略（如VLA和WAM），这些策略泛化性差、鲁棒性不足。论文要探究通用AI模型直接控制机械臂的“智能体式操作策略”（AMPs）能否更可靠、更通用地完成操作任务。
ai_summary.method: 提出AMP1，一个无需示教、无需任务特定训练的统一执行框架，让通用AI模型直接向机械臂下达指令，并根据任务进展动态调整动作；同一框架可跨单臂、双臂和移动操作平台运行。框架本身不提供抓取、推、放等技能，由智能体自行发展策略；再加入跨回合持久记忆存储后，智能体可从经验中学习。
ai_summary.result: 在RoboLab-120上零样本成功率达85.6%，远超领先VLA（49.2%）和WAM（42.9%）；在108次真实机器人试验（12个任务、3个机器人实例）中零样本成功104次，失败率相对VLA和WAM基线分别降低20倍和15倍。加入记忆后在RoboDojo双臂任务上失败率再降4.6倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地论证并验证“通用AI模型直接作为操作策略”的智能体范式，无需示教与任务训练即可跨多种机器人形态达到SOTA，并展现自发工具使用、寻找隐藏物体、相机自校准等涌现行为。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人操作提供了一条区别于专业VLA/WAM的新范式，说明通用智能体模型可作为更通用、更鲁棒的操作基础，对具身智能与通用机器人策略研究具有重要启发意义。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
papers.abstract: When should a robot look at the cup, and when at the portafilter? Spatial-reasoning benchmarks evaluate whether a model can describe a scene, but manipulation needs something more specific: the ability to acquire the particular evidence that makes the current command executable. A view that is informative for one task can be useless for another, even at the same workstation. We introduce Seeing What Matters, a benchmark for task-conditioned actionable spatial belief in simulated tabletop manipulation. Across three domains--coffee workstation, drawer/cabinet, and microwave/appliance--the benchmark provides 860 frozen evaluation cases; expanding across methods, budgets, and inference repeats yields more than 115,000 evaluator episodes under two protocols: closed-loop actionability and same-object functional out-of-distribution generalization. Each case pairs a set of candidate RGB views with a manipulation command, shared scripted skills, and hidden postconditions, so the benchmark directly measures whether a view-selection policy acquires the observations its command actually needs. We also provide a diagnostic reference pipeline that maintains a spatial-functional belief state and ranks views by missing evidence. At primary budget settings, this pipeline reaches 98.8% closed-loop and 98.9% functional-OOD success; ablating the functional or command-binding components collapses performance to near zero. Seven vision-language models, evaluated on the same cases, reach only 26-43%. Replacing the reference pipeline's coverage metadata with frozen RGB-derived scores preserves 98.5%/98.9% success; shuffling the visual scores collapses it to 15%/11%, confirming that the result depends on image content. These gaps suggest that spatial belief for manipulation should be evaluated not by scene-level completeness, but by whether it acquires the evidence the current command requires.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人操作需要根据当前任务主动获取可执行命令所需的空间证据，而现有空间推理基准多评估场景描述或场景级完整性，无法衡量任务条件下的可操作空间信念。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Seeing What Matters 基准，在咖啡台、抽屉/柜子和微波炉/电器三个模拟桌面操作领域中提供860个冻结评测案例，每个案例配对候选RGB视角、操作命令、共享脚本技能和隐藏后置条件，并在闭环可操作性与同物体功能OOD泛化两种协议下评测视角选择策略。作者还提供一个诊断性参考流水线，维护空间-功能信念状态并按缺失证据对视角排序。
ai_summary.result: 参考流水线在主预算设置下达到98.8%闭环成功率和98.9%功能OOD成功率，消融功能组件或命令绑定组件后性能接近零；七个视觉语言模型仅达到26-43%。用冻结RGB派生分数替换覆盖元数据仍保持98.5%/98.9%成功率，而打乱视觉分数后降至15%/11%，说明结果依赖图像内容。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将操作中的空间信念评测从场景级完整性转向“当前命令所需证据”的任务条件可操作性，并设计了闭环与功能OOD协议及诊断参考流水线。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为具身智能、机器人操作和多模态空间推理提供了更贴近任务执行的评测范式，强调模型应主动获取可执行证据而非仅描述场景。

papers.title: ODEAction: From Predicting Chunks to Evolving Actions
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically generate actions in chunks, organizing continuous robot execution into separately predicted segments and thus introducing potential discontinuities at action-chunk transitions. We propose ODEAction, a chunk-free action generation paradigm that replaces action-chunk prediction with Continuous Action Evolution. Given visual observations, language instructions, and robot proprioceptive information, ODEAction learns an action transition field defined over action space, where a transition vector characterizes the evolution rate of the current action with respect to evolution time. During execution, the model takes the current action as its initial condition and integrates the learned field using an ordinary differential equation (ODE), recursively generating subsequent actions with explicit dependencies. ODEAction is implemented as an action head and does not depend on a specific vision-language backbone architecture. Experiments on LIBERO, EBench, RoboTwin, and real robots show that ODEAction improves both task performance and trajectory quality over matched action-chunking baselines, with particularly pronounced gains on fine manipulation tasks.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常分块预测动作，导致动作块切换处可能出现不连续，影响机器人执行的平滑性和精细操作质量。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ODEAction，用连续动作演化替代动作块预测：在动作空间学习一个动作转移场，以当前动作为初始条件，通过 ODE 积分该场递归生成后续动作，形成显式依赖的连续动作序列。该方法实现为动作头，不依赖特定 VLA 主干架构。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO、EBench、RoboTwin 和真实机器人上的实验表明，ODEAction 相比匹配的动作分块基线提升了任务性能和轨迹质量，在精细操作任务上提升尤其明显。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动作生成从“分块预测”转变为基于学习动作转移场的连续 ODE 演化，实现无块且具有显式动作依赖的生成范式。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 和机器人动作生成提供了一种可插拔的连续动作建模思路，有望改善长程执行平滑性与精细操作表现。

papers.title: Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
papers.abstract: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study's modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.

ai_summary.problem: 放射科AI存在专用模型覆盖病种少、通用模型易幻觉和测量不准的矛盾；现有agentic系统多局限于单一模态或部位，需评估用生产级FDA获批工具能否实现全面报告。
ai_summary.method: 提出标准化放射科agentic框架：由orchestrator调用模块化工具生成结构化报告；在多模态报告语料上模拟报告生成，分别使用FDA获批设备整合的发现类别目录或无限制目录，并分别基于临床指征或目标报告进行规划；工具输出由参考报告模拟，以隔离工具可用性与编排能力的影响。
ai_summary.result: 仅用获批目录和临床指征时，只能恢复不到三分之一的临床可操作发现；无限制目录显著提升，基于目标报告规划进一步提升。多数漏检源于该检查模态无获批设备覆盖，约三分之一是已提供类别/工具未被调用；补充最常缺失工具可弥合大部分差距，而较小orchestrator用无限制目录也无法获得增益。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了可标准化评估放射科agentic编排的框架，并用FDA获批AI工具目录量化工具可用性与编排能力的互补约束。
ai_summary.relevance: 为放射科agentic AI的实际落地指出关键瓶颈：全面报告依赖工具覆盖与有效编排共同提升，而非仅靠更强通用模型。

papers.title: BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
papers.abstract: 3D spatial reasoning from video remains challenging for VLMs because videos provide sequential, view-local observations rather than persistent metric scene records. Many questions must be answered in a query-specified perspective rather than the observed camera viewpoint, and prompting with a fixed set of RGB views may miss sparse or occluded visual cues. To address these gaps, we introduce BEV3SR, a training-free and backbone-agnostic framework for RGB-D videos with camera parameters. BEV3SR turns video observations into queryable metric bird's-eye-view (BEV) scene memory and formalizes each query into an evidence-aware spatial task. The Spatial Task Formalizer specifies the query's reference frame, spatial constraints, objective, and evidence requirement. The evidence requirement determines the appropriate reasoning pathway. A query treated as requiring geometric evidence is handled by the Geometric Reasoner, which deterministically computes the answer using the metric BEV records in the query-specified reference frame. Otherwise, a query treated as requiring visual evidence is passed to the Visual Evidence Aligner, which uses BEV-indexed object records and their associated supporting views to retrieve object-consistent and scene-context RGB frames for VLM grounding. Within a standard 16-frame budget, BEV3SR consistently improves different VLM backbones across multiple 3D scene QA benchmarks, delivering large gains on spatially intensive questions and significant improvements on open-ended scene QA. These results demonstrate that BEV3SR offers an effective, efficient, and interpretable framework for explicit 3D spatial reasoning from video.

ai_summary.problem: 视频中的3D空间推理对视觉语言模型（VLM）具有挑战性，因为视频只提供序列化、视角局部的观测，而非持久度量场景记录；此外，查询常要求从指定视角回答，固定RGB视图提示可能遗漏稀疏或遮挡的视觉线索。
ai_summary.method: 提出BEV3SR，一种无需训练、骨干无关的框架，利用带相机参数的RGB-D视频构建可查询的度量鸟瞰图（BEV）场景记忆，并将查询形式化为证据感知空间任务。空间任务形式化器确定参考系、空间约束、目标和证据需求；几何证据查询由几何推理器在指定参考系中基于BEV度量记录确定性计算，视觉证据查询则由视觉证据对齐器利用BEV索引的对象记录及支持视图检索对象一致且含场景上下文的RGB帧供VLM grounding。
ai_summary.result: 在标准16帧预算下，BEV3SR在多个3D场景问答基准上稳定提升不同VLM骨干，在空间密集问题上取得大幅增益，并在开放式场景问答上显著改进。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是证据感知地路由查询，将确定性度量BEV几何推理与BEV索引的视觉证据对齐结合，实现无需训练且可解释的视频3D空间推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型和具身智能中的显式视频3D空间推理提供了高效、有效且可解释的框架。

papers.title: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over $1,000$ sequential updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型需要持续更新事实知识，但终身知识编辑面临严重的局部性侵蚀和灾难性遗忘，顺序编辑会干扰预训练能力和先前更新。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出ROSE框架，将参数更新限制在先前编辑子空间的正交补中，并引入动态风险掩码保护关键事实参数子空间；推理时采用原型锚定语义门控和扰动驱动子空间融合的多粒度知识整合策略。
ai_summary.result: 在两个主流多模态基准、五个关键指标上，ROSE与最先进方法具有竞争力，并在1000次顺序更新中保持出色稳定性。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是风险感知的正交子空间导航机制，结合推理阶段的多粒度知识融合，以缓解终身多模态知识编辑中的遗忘和干扰。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的持续事实更新提供了一种兼顾新知识注入与旧知识/通用能力保持的终身编辑思路。

papers.title: AnimWeb-Bench: Benchmarking Animated Webpage Code Generation from Videos
papers.abstract: Animation is pervasive on the Web, the CSS animation property alone appears on over three-quarters of webpages. Yet existing webpage code generation benchmarks target static screenshots, user-triggered interactions, or isolated motion graphics, leaving the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and coding agents to reconstruct complete animated webpages largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce AnimWeb-Bench, the first benchmark for animated webpage code generation from videos. It comprises 124 real-world webpages spanning 7 application domains and 33 animation types, with 91.9% of pages combining multiple types, each paired with a reference video and the static assets of the original webpage. We further propose a human-aligned, two-dimensional evaluation protocol: Static Appearance Fidelity measures structure, text, color, and visual similarity on aligned keyframes, while Animation Fidelity tracks UI components across frames and compares their position, size, velocity, and appearance with those in the reference video. Evaluating 14 MLLMs and three coding agents reveals: (1) reproducing webpage animations is substantially more difficult than reproducing static appearance; (2) explicit frame inspection and render feedback improve the reconstruction quality of coding agents; and (3) rapid, continuous changes are harder to reproduce than discrete state transitions. Our code and dataset are available at https://starry1001.github.io/AnimWeb-Bench-website/ .

ai_summary.problem: 现有网页代码生成基准主要针对静态截图、用户触发交互或孤立动效，缺乏从视频重建完整动画网页的评测基准。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AnimWeb-Bench，首个从视频生成动画网页代码的基准，包含124个真实网页、7个应用领域和33种动画类型，并提供参考视频与静态资源；同时设计静态外观保真度和动画保真度两个维度的评测协议。
ai_summary.result: 评测14个多模态大模型和3个编码智能体发现：复现网页动画显著难于复现静态外观；显式帧检查和渲染反馈能提升编码智能体重建质量；快速连续变化比离散状态切换更难复现。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个面向视频到完整动画网页代码生成的基准，并提出与人类对齐的静态外观与动画双维度评测协议。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型和编码智能体在动态网页理解与生成方面提供了更贴近真实Web动画的评测平台。

papers.title: SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have become a promising paradigm for end-to-end robot control, but their effectiveness still depends heavily on large volumes of demonstration data. In manipulation tasks, this dependence is compounded by structured spatiotemporal uncertainty in the action space: multiple nearby actions or trajectories may successfully solve the same task, while semantically equivalent demonstrations often unfold at different speeds. Standard pointwise supervision treats each demonstrated action as an exact target, imposing an unnecessary learning burden under such uncertainty. We present SURE, a data-efficient VLA training framework that explicitly models both spatial and temporal uncertainty. SURE augments a VLA backbone with a lightweight transposed-convolutional probabilistic action decoder that captures spatial uncertainty through local correlations among neighboring action bins. It further introduces Soft-DTW alignment supervision to accommodate local timing variations between predicted and demonstrated action chunks. Together, these two components reduce sensitivity to demonstrator-specific poses and execution timing, enabling more data-efficient action learning. We evaluate SURE on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks. Even with only 10% of the demonstration data or 20% of the training steps, SURE achieves manipulation success rates that match or surpass baseline VLAs.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作任务中依赖大量示教数据，而动作空间存在结构化的时空不确定性——多个相近动作/轨迹都能完成任务，等价示教的速度也常不同，传统的逐点监督把每个示教动作当作精确目标，带来了不必要的学习负担。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SURE 训练框架，在 VLA 主干上增加一个轻量的转置卷积概率动作解码器，通过相邻动作 bin 的局部相关性建模空间不确定性；同时引入 Soft-DTW 对齐监督，以容忍预测动作块与示教动作块之间的局部时序变化，从而降低对示教者特定姿态和执行节奏的敏感度。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 以及真实机器人操作任务上，SURE 仅用 10% 的示教数据或 20% 的训练步数，就能达到与基线 VLA 相当甚至更高的操作成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动作空间的空间不确定性（邻域概率建模）与时序不确定性（Soft-DTW 柔性对齐）统一到 VLA 训练中，显著提升数据与训练效率。
ai_summary.relevance: 为数据高效的具身智能与 VLA 策略学习提供了可插拔的监督范式，有助于降低真实机器人数据采集成本。

papers.title: Decoupled Mode Connectivity for Base-to-Novel Generalization in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models such as CLIP by optimizing a short learnable prompt. The cross-entropy objective pulls this prompt toward   base-class specialization, whereas generalization to unseen classes benefits from staying close to CLIP's zero-shot feature space. Because both objectives   act on the same prompt, their gradients conflict at convergence, and in our experiments no single-prompt loss design clearly improves on the cosine   baseline. We propose Decoupled Mode Connectivity (DMC), which gives each objective its own prompt. Starting from a base-trained prompt, DMC trains a   specialization prompt and a generalization prompt, and merges their text features with a fixed coefficient at test time, at the inference cost of a single   prompt. A linear mode connectivity (LMC) corridor in text-feature space keeps the classification loss low for every classifier interpolated between the two   endpoints, and a Visual Anchor KL term preserves CLIP's zero-shot class-similarity distribution of each image during specialization. We further argue that   such regularizers should satisfy class-permutation invariance (CPI), and show via Fano's inequality, in an idealized model, that violating CPI   lower-bounds the drop in novel accuracy by a term proportional to the mutual information between the prompt and the base-class labels. Across 11 datasets,   DMC improves the average harmonic mean of base and novel accuracy over MergeTune for both CoOp and KgCoOp, and its interpolation curves pass beyond the   single-prompt operating point, shifting the base-novel frontier rather than trading along it. Code is available at https://github.com/IemProg/DMC.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（如CLIP）的提示学习在适配基类时容易牺牲对未见类别的泛化能力，交叉熵目标与保持零样本特征空间的目标在同一提示上产生梯度冲突。
ai_summary.method: 提出解耦模式连通性（DMC），为基类专门化和泛化分别训练独立提示，并在测试时以固定系数融合文本特征；同时利用文本特征空间的线性模式连通性走廊和视觉锚定KL正则，保持插值分类器性能并保留CLIP的零样本类相似度分布。
ai_summary.result: 在11个数据集上，DMC对CoOp和KgCoOp均提升了基类与新颖类准确率的调和平均，并优于MergeTune；其插值曲线能越过单提示工作点，推动基类-新颖类前沿而非仅在前沿上权衡。
ai_summary.novelty: 将模式连通性引入提示学习的基类-新颖类泛化，通过解耦两个目标并为每个目标分配独立提示来避免梯度冲突，同时提出类置换不变性视角和理论分析。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉语言模型的高效适配提供了一种兼顾基类性能与开放类泛化的新思路，对提示学习和多模态迁移学习有参考价值。

papers.title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.

ai_summary.problem: 当前基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在需要长期记忆和规划的任务上仍难以超越人类表现，论文旨在解决MBRL中的长期记忆问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning（TT-MBRL），在测试时通过梯度下降将每回合观测的记忆编码进世界模型参数，从而为每个回合学习一个独立的世界模型；并在Memory Maze 2D、3D Memory Maze以及DeepMind Control和Atari 100k上验证。
ai_summary.result: TT-MBRL在不同世界模型架构上均带来稳定提升，并在Memory Maze基准上取得新的state-of-the-art，同时在非记忆类基准上保持强性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是从测试时参数适配而非模型架构设计入手，将长期记忆直接编码到世界模型参数中。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型和基于模型的强化学习提供了新的记忆机制思路，说明测试时学习可增强智能体的长期记忆与规划能力。

papers.title: SPSC: Zero-Shot Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Reconstruction via Semantic Preservation and Subspace Calibration
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language models and diffusion generators have driven rapid progress in brain-to-image generation, while EEG-based reconstruction is still constrained by low signal-to-noise ratio and cross-subject semantic shifts. Zero-shot cross-subject reconstruction poses even greater challenges: EEG semantic embeddings learned from source subjects deviate from the manifold of image embeddings of the unseen target subject, particularly when neither target labels nor target image embeddings are available. To address this issue, we introduce the Semantic Preservation and Subspace Calibration (SPSC) framework, which first uses Object Mask Contrastive Regularization (OMCR) with object identity for backend training, and then constructs Subspace Candidate Gate (SCG) to achieve label-free semantic correction for target subjects during inference. Specifically, OMCR regularizes the conditioning space with object-level positive samples to preserve object-level feature neighborhoods within the reconstruction prior and low-level branch, while SCG exploits training image prototypes and batch statistics of unlabeled target EEG to select candidates for each task within subspaces of image prototypes. Under the leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) setting across ten subjects on the THINGS-EEG dataset, SPSC improves the cross-subject reconstruction from 0.552 to 0.713 on CLIP and from 0.612 to 0.745 on Alex.5. These significant gains indicate that the semantically calibrated conditions can better support generation for the target subjects under label-free inference.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决零样本跨被试 EEG-to-Image 重建中，源被试学习到的 EEG 语义嵌入与未见目标被试的图像嵌入流形存在偏差，且缺少目标标签和目标图像嵌入的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SPSC 框架：训练阶段使用带物体身份的 Object Mask Contrastive Regularization（OMCR）约束条件空间，保留物体级特征邻域；推理阶段构建 Subspace Candidate Gate（SCG），利用训练图像原型和无标签目标 EEG 的批统计信息，在图像原型子空间内为每个任务选择候选，实现无标签语义校正。
ai_summary.result: 在 THINGS-EEG 十被试 LOSO 设置下，跨被试重建 CLIP 指标从 0.552 提升到 0.713，Alex.5 从 0.612 提升到 0.745。
ai_summary.novelty: 结合物体身份对比正则与无标签子空间候选门控，实现推理阶段的目标被试语义校准，从而提升零样本跨被试 EEG-to-Image 重建。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推进了无标签跨被试脑到图像解码，对生成式脑机接口和语义校准方法具有参考价值。

papers.title: Flow-Guided Target-Space Alignment via Path Consistency
papers.abstract: Many multimodal alignment problems require mapping a source modality into a fixed space defined by a target modality, where the target space is not merely an intermediate embedding but is used directly for downstream analysis. In this setting, successful alignment should preserve both the global structure of the target distribution and the instance-level correspondence observed in paired source--target training data. Existing objectives typically address only part of this goal: contrastive losses encourage relative similarity, distribution-matching losses improve marginal agreement, and pointwise regression fits each source sample to its paired target without explicitly modeling target-space path geometry. We propose FlowAlign, a flow-guided target-space alignment method that repurposes conditional flow matching as a training-time alignment signal rather than an inference-time transport model. FlowAlign uses the learned flow field to guide the alignment of source-side representations with the fixed target space, encouraging them to preserve paired correspondence while remaining compatible with the global target-space structure. We further provide theoretical analysis showing how FlowAlign helps improve paired correspondence by controlling endpoint accuracy and capturing local target-space geometry. Experiments on synthetic data, paired single-cell multiome benchmarks, and image--text alignment demonstrate that FlowAlign improves instance level correspondence while preserving target-space structure across different modality settings.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态对齐任务中，需要把源模态映射到由目标模态定义的固定空间，而现有对比损失、分布匹配损失和逐点回归各只能覆盖部分目标：要么只保持相对相似性，要么只对齐边缘分布，要么只拟合配对点，难以同时保持目标空间的全局结构和实例级配对对应关系。
ai_summary.method: 提出 FlowAlign，把条件流匹配从推理阶段的传输模型改造为训练阶段的对齐信号：利用学习到的流场引导源侧表示向固定目标空间对齐，使表示既保持配对样本的对应关系，又与目标分布的全局结构兼容。作者还给出理论分析，说明通过控制端点精度、捕捉目标空间局部几何来提升配对一致性。
ai_summary.result: 在合成数据、配对单细胞多组学（multiome）基准以及图文对齐任务上，FlowAlign 在不同模态设置下均提升了实例级对应精度，同时保持了目标空间的结构。
ai_summary.novelty: 把条件流匹配重新定位为训练期的对齐正则/引导信号（而非推理期的传输模型），用流的路径几何同时约束端点精度与目标空间局部结构。
ai_summary.relevance: 为跨模态对齐提供了一种兼顾全局分布结构与实例级配对的通用目标函数，可推广到单细胞多组学、图文等多模态表征学习场景，对流匹配在世界模型与多模态表征中的应用也有启发。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Benchmarking of Unified Multimodal Models for Shallow-Water UAV Image Distortion Assessment and Restoration
papers.abstract: Shallow-water UAV imagery provides centimeter-scale observations of benthic environments, but water-induced distortions complicate interpretation. To our knowledge, we present the first systematic zero-shot benchmark of unified multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for both assessing water-induced distortions and restoring shallow-water imagery within the same model framework. We evaluate five open-weight unified MLLMs with frozen pretrained weights and without access to paired reference images or descriptions of the true seabed. The benchmark contains 1,000 image pairs: 600 semi-synthetic UAV scenes created by applying synthetic water distortions to real shallow-water imagery and 400 fully synthetic through-water scenes. Three independent human annotations cover five distortion types. We evaluate four assessment prompts (P0-P3), from direct instruction to structured task decomposition, on all 1,000 images and four diagnosis-guided restoration prompts (R0-R3) on a common 100-image subset. Assessment varies substantially by model and prompt, with systematic prediction biases and a best pooled balanced accuracy of 0.654 for distortion presence. The best pooled PSNR gain is +0.255 dB, no unified MLLM improves pooled LPIPS, and some outputs alter scene structure or hallucinate content. Two restoration-only baselines also show limited transfer: InstructIR achieves a pooled PSNR gain of +0.040 dB, while PromptFix degrades all four pooled metrics under every prompt. These results show that recognizing shallow-water degradation does not imply reliable physical restoration and provide a reproducible baseline for future work.

ai_summary.problem: 浅水无人机图像受水体诱导畸变影响，难以直接解读；论文旨在零样本条件下系统评测统一多模态大模型能否同时完成畸变评估与图像复原。
ai_summary.method: 构建包含1000对图像的基准，其中600对为半合成真实浅水场景、400对为全合成穿水场景，并由三人独立标注五类畸变；在冻结权重、无参考图像和真实海底描述条件下，评测5个开源统一MLLM在4种评估提示和4种诊断引导复原提示下的表现。
ai_summary.result: 评估性能随模型和提示差异显著，畸变存在性的最佳汇总平衡准确率仅0.654；最佳PSNR增益为+0.255 dB，但没有统一MLLM改善汇总LPIPS，部分输出改变场景结构或产生幻觉；复原专用基线也表现有限。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地零样本基准评测统一多模态大模型在浅水无人机图像畸变评估与原位复原中的能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了多模态模型“能识别退化”不等于“能可靠物理复原”，为世界模型/多模态模型在科学观测与图像复原中的可信评测提供了可复现基线。

papers.title: Fixed-point acceleration on Neural Wasserstein manifolds
papers.abstract: We propose a fixed-point acceleration method for optimization over probability measures, applicable to a variety of machine learning problems. We represent probability measures as pushforwards of a reference distribution through a neural network map and equip the parameter space with the induced pullback Wasserstein metric. This geometric structure allows natural gradient descent to be interpreted as a fixed-point iteration on a Riemannian manifold. We accelerate this iteration using Riemannian Anderson mixing method, which exploits historical residuals to capture approximate second-order information without forming Hessians. In the present parametric setting, the manifold is represented by Euclidean coordinates endowed with a point-dependent metric, simplifying retraction and vector transport. We evaluate the method on multimodal sampling, PDE-based inverse problems, aggregation dynamics, Bayesian logistic regression, and generative modeling. Across the tested tasks, Anderson mixing reduces the number of natural-gradient iterations and achieves competitive performance relative to SGD and Adam in terms of both loss-gradient evaluations and wall-clock time. These results suggest that fixed-point acceleration is an efficient tool for improving the computational efficiency of training on parametric Wasserstein methods.

ai_summary.problem: 论文针对概率测度空间上的优化问题（Wasserstein 自然梯度类方法），这类方法虽几何性质良好，但每次迭代需计算自然梯度，计算开销大、收敛慢，限制了其在实际机器学习任务中的应用。
ai_summary.method: 将概率测度表示为参考分布经神经网络映射后的前推（pushforward），并在参数空间上赋予诱导的拉回 Wasserstein 度量，使自然梯度下降等价于黎曼流形上的不动点迭代；随后用黎曼 Anderson 混合（利用历史残差近似二阶信息、无需构造 Hessian）加速该迭代，并在欧氏坐标加点点依赖度量的参数化下简化 retraction 与向量传输。
ai_summary.result: 在多模态采样、基于 PDE 的逆问题、聚集动力学、贝叶斯逻辑回归和生成建模等任务上，Anderson 加速显著减少了自然梯度迭代次数，并在梯度评估次数与实际运行时间上与 SGD、Adam 具有竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将黎曼 Anderson 不动点加速与神经网络参数化的拉回 Wasserstein 自然梯度结合，在无需二阶导的情况下高效近似二阶信息。
ai_summary.relevance: 为采样、贝叶斯推断与基于 Wasserstein 的生成建模等测度优化任务提供了提升训练效率的通用加速工具。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者未提供机构信息）

papers.title: Embedding Predictive Adaptation and Refinement for Multi-Modal Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) has evolved from 2D image-based approaches to multi-modal methods that leverage the complementary nature of RGB images and 3D point clouds. Among these, memory bank-based methods, which identify anomalies by the discrepancy between each query patch feature and its nearest normal prototype, have proven particularly effective. However, two limitations remain: (i) employing frozen pretrained encoders yields insufficient discrimination between normal and anomalous features due to the domain gap, while existing contrastive learning-based adaptation struggles to capture the spatial relationships required for precise localization; and (ii) pixel-level anomaly maps interpolated from patch-level distance scores remain coarse, lacking fine-grained detail. To address these limitations, we propose EPAR (Embedding Predictive Adaptation and Refinement). We adapt encoders by predicting the embeddings of masked regions to capture spatial relationships, together with patch-level Variance-Invariance-Covariance (VIC) regularization, resolving the poor discriminability between normal and anomalous features caused by the domain gap. We further propose a Noise Suppression Network that refines coarse maps by learning the relational discrepancy between each patch feature and its nearest normal prototype, rather than the anomaly's appearance. This relational signal remains valid for unseen real defects, despite being learned from synthetic anomalies. EPAR demonstrates strong practical applicability, excelling in few-shot settings and improving AUPRO@1% on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies by +1.8% and +1.9%, respectively.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态工业异常检测中，冻结预训练编码器因域差距导致正常/异常特征区分不足，且由块级距离分数插值得到的像素级异常图较粗糙、缺乏细粒度细节。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EPAR：通过预测掩码区域嵌入来适配编码器以捕捉空间关系，并结合块级方差-不变性-协方差（VIC）正则化提升特征判别力；同时设计噪声抑制网络，基于每个块特征与其最近正常原型的关系差异而非异常外观来细化粗糙异常图。
ai_summary.result: 在 MVTec 3D-AD 和 Eyecandies 上 AUPRO@1% 分别提升 +1.8% 和 +1.9%，在少样本设置下表现良好，具有较强的实际适用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将嵌入预测式编码器适配与基于关系差异的噪声抑制细化相结合，用于多模态工业异常检测。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升多模态工业异常检测的定位精度和少样本泛化能力，对3D视觉与工业质检应用有实际意义。

papers.title: FusionCLIP: Multimodal Contrastive Pretraining for Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
papers.abstract: Visible-light videos and multivariate diagnostic signals provide complementary observations of tokamak discharges. However, existing fusion pretraining methods, primarily learn representations by reconstructing or predicting observations, leaving the correspondence between these modalities underexplored. Representation learning is further challenged by the fact that plasma-related regions occupy only part of each video frame and diagnostic variables have substantially different sampling rates. We propose FusionCLIP, a multimodal contrastive pretraining framework. Spatiotemporal Stability Selection retains informative visual tokens, while a Temporal Query Encoder integrates asynchronous diagnostic signals using their observation timestamps. Contrastive learning then aligns the two modality representations. We construct EAST Multimodal Diagnostics (EAST-MMD), comprising 1307 EAST discharges, and evaluate the model on three independently fine-tuned tasks: disruption prediction, edge-localized mode (ELM) classification, and $H_{98}$ regression. FusionCLIP achieves an aggregate score of 89.07\%, exceeding the best general-purpose pretraining configuration and an in-domain contrastive pretraining configuration without Spatiotemporal Stability Selection by 6.27 and 2.12 percentage points, respectively. Ablations and attention visualizations further support the contributions of its key components.

ai_summary.problem: 聚变托卡马克诊断中的可见光视频与多变量诊断信号具有互补性，但现有聚变预训练方法多基于重建或预测，未充分挖掘两种模态间的对应关系；同时等离子体相关区域只占画面一部分、诊断变量采样率差异大，使表征学习困难。
ai_summary.method: 提出 FusionCLIP 多模态对比预训练框架：用时空稳定性选择（Spatiotemporal Stability Selection）筛选有信息量的视觉 token，用时间查询编码器（Temporal Query Encoder）依据观测时间戳整合异步诊断信号，再通过对比学习对齐两种模态的表征。同时构建了包含 1307 次 EAST 放电的 EAST-MMD 数据集。
ai_summary.result: 在破裂预测、边缘局域模（ELM）分类和 H98 回归三个独立微调任务上，FusionCLIP 综合得分 89.07%，分别比最佳通用预训练配置和去掉时空稳定性选择的域内对比预训练配置高 6.27 和 2.12 个百分点；消融实验与注意力可视化进一步验证了关键组件的贡献。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将跨模态对比对齐引入聚变诊断预训练，并针对稀疏等离子体区域与异步多采样率信号设计了稳定性选择和时间查询编码机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多模态对比学习在科学观测数据（视频＋异步传感器）上的有效性，为跨模态、异步时序的科学与具身感知预训练提供了可借鉴范式。

papers.title: Multimodal Training with Knowledge Traction for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: The task of weakly supervised video anomaly detection is challenging. Existing approaches mainly model video frame features and determine whether anomalies are present based on their magnitudes. In this work, we propose a novel method that incorporates external knowledge into training to improve model performance, robustness, and generalization. We leverage textual prompts and a large language model (LLM) to establish prior information for the specific task, and employ dictionary learning to normalize and compress this information. Moreover, during experiments, we observed inconsistencies in the textual descriptions extracted from similar video frames by image caption models. To address this, we devise a method that leverages an LLM and auxiliary information to ensure consistency in the textual descriptions of similar frames within a video. Finally, we introduce a feature processing approach that incorporates prior knowledge and cross-modal attention mechanisms. This approach learns the relationships and characteristics among different modalities to construct more accurate and reliable feature representations, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses other state-of-the-art approaches.

ai_summary.problem: 弱监督视频异常检测中，现有方法仅依赖视频帧特征的幅度判断异常，缺乏外部知识且对同源帧的文本描述不一致，导致性能、鲁棒性和泛化性受限。
ai_summary.method: 利用文本提示和大语言模型（LLM）构建任务先验知识，并通过字典学习对其进行归一化与压缩；针对图像描述模型对相似帧生成不一致文本的问题，设计借助LLM与辅助信息的一致性约束方法；最后提出融合先验知识与跨模态注意力的特征处理方式，学习多模态间关系以构建更可靠的视频特征表示。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Learning Framework for Linking Microscopic Surface Degradation to Bolted Joint Functional Behavior
papers.abstract: Returned products in circular engineering often have heterogeneous degradation histories, making remaining function difficult to assess. For bolted joints, corrosion alters surface morphology, contact, friction, preload retention, and mechanical response. This paper presents a physics-informed multimodal framework for linking microscopic and camera-based degradation observations to functional indicators of corroded bolted joints. The workflow defines the corrosion failure mode, generates synchronized inspection and functional-response records, preprocesses image, roughness, exposure, and joint descriptors, aligns microscopy and camera observations through similarity learning, and constructs a calibrated corrosion-severity field. Partial differential equation (PDE) discovery is applied to this field to identify candidate effective mesoscale laws rather than complete electrochemical mechanisms. The corrosion-evolution model is coupled to a separate functional model, with friction coefficient as the primary target and preload loss included when clamp-force data are available. The contribution is a reproducible pathway for physically constrained assessment of degraded bolted-joint behavior.

ai_summary.problem: 面向循环工程中退化历史异质的回收螺栓连接件，难以评估其剩余功能；腐蚀会改变表面形貌、接触、摩擦、预紧力保持和力学响应。
ai_summary.method: 提出一个物理信息多模态框架：生成同步的检测与功能响应记录，预处理图像、粗糙度、暴露和连接描述符，通过相似性学习对齐显微与相机观测，构建校准的腐蚀严重度场，并用PDE发现识别中尺度有效演化规律，再与功能模型耦合预测摩擦系数和预紧力损失。
ai_summary.result: 论文给出了一条可复现的、受物理约束的退化螺栓连接功能评估路径；摘要未提供定量性能结果。
ai_summary.novelty: 将PDE发现得到的腐蚀演化场模型与螺栓连接功能模型耦合，实现从微观表面退化到功能指标的物理约束多模态建模。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了物理信息多模态学习在工业退化评估与剩余寿命/功能预测中的潜力，对AI驱动的工程系统健康管理有一定参考价值。

papers.title: DataHelix: A CPU-GPU Co-Scheduling Data Plane for Multimodal Model Training
papers.abstract: Multimodal model training breaks the loose coupling between data loading and model execution assumed by conventional training pipelines. Large per-sample variation in decoding cost, token/latent count, and tensor size causes both CPU preprocessing time and GPU compute time to vary substantially across data-parallel ranks (training processes). In synchronous training, these two sources of heterogeneity interact tightly: GPU execution determines how long the input pipeline has to prepare the next batch, while delayed preprocessing in any rank in turn stalls all GPUs at synchronization. As a result, optimizing CPU throughput or GPU load balance in isolation cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles. We present DataHelix, a metadata-first CPU-GPU co-scheduling data plane for multimodal training. DataHelix jointly reasons about preprocessing demand and GPU execution progress, treating each GPU compute window as the readiness budget for the next batch and coordinating preprocessing across ranks to minimize deadline misses rather than CPU makespan. To avoid expensive data movement, placement is decided while samples remain lightweight descriptors, before decoding and collation amplify them into large tensors. Descriptor-level token-latent-aware batching performs coarse pre-balancing, while cost-gated collective rebalancing corrects residual skew only when its expected benefit exceeds transfer cost. Across 11 video and multimodal workloads on 8 Ascend 910B accelerators, DataHelix reduces mean deadline-miss rate by 67.8% and mean p95 input-wait latency by 87.0%, while achieving 2.72x geometric-mean throughput over rank-local DataLoaders and 1.82x over a Ray actor pool under the same CPU budget.

papers.title: PreForceVision: Physics-Guided Optical Estimation of Bolt Preload from Bolt-Head Deformation
papers.abstract: Bolt preload is a decisive functional quantity in bolted joints because it determines whether external loads are transmitted primarily through frictional clamping or directly through the bolt. Existing preload measurement techniques, including strain-gauge bolts, force washers, ultrasonic methods, and bolt-length measurements, are effective in certain applications but require additional hardware, coupling, calibration, or joint modifications. This limits their scalability for large numbers of standard fasteners and motivates a non-contact optical approach. This paper proposes PreForceVision, a physics-guided optical framework for estimating bolt preload from preload-induced surface deformation of the bolt-head front face. The method treats preload estimation as an inverse deformation-to-force problem, where deformation of the optically accessible bolt-head surface is extracted from reference-loaded image pairs and related to the internal preload state. Preliminary results for an M16 strength class 8.8 bolt show an approximately \SI{12}{\micro\meter} simulated head-face depression at \SI{90}{\kilo\newton}, strain-gauge measurements of comparable magnitude, and an optical 3D measured central depression of approximately \SIrange{10}{20}{\micro\meter}. The contribution is a physics-guided optical methodology combining controlled image-pair acquisition, DIC- or optical-flow-based deformation extraction, multimodal validation, and uncertainty-aware regression for rough preload estimation under controlled conditions.

ai_summary.problem: 现有螺栓预紧力测量方法需要额外硬件、耦合、标定或接头改造，难以扩展到大量标准紧固件，因此需要一种非接触式光学测量方法。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 PreForceVision，将预紧力估计建模为从变形到力的逆问题；通过受控的参考/加载图像对提取螺栓头前端面的预紧诱发变形，并使用 DIC 或光流进行变形提取，结合多模态验证和不确定性感知回归来估计预紧力。
ai_summary.result: M16 8.8 级螺栓的初步结果显示：90 kN 下仿真头面凹陷约 12 微米，应变片测量量级相当，光学 3D 测得中心凹陷约 10–20 微米；可在受控条件下实现粗略预紧力估计。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出一种物理引导的光学方法，将受控图像对采集、DIC/光流变形提取、多模态验证和不确定性感知回归结合用于螺栓预紧力非接触估计。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了物理引导视觉与回归在工业测量中的应用，但对世界模型、多模态大模型、Agent、具身智能等 AI 前沿方向直接影响有限。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 多模态以压倒性占比（约17/20）主导今日论文，其中具身智能/VLA最为密集：从动作分块预测转向连续ODE演化、时空不确定性建模与任务条件空间信念评测，呈现“策略生成范式重构+评测基准补位”并行推进的态势。Agentic范式开始溢出到机器人操作与放射科等垂直场景，同时工业/科学多模态（聚变诊断、异常检测、腐蚀-预紧力建模）成为稳定的长尾应用带。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日抓取结果中大厂论文分布为空，无法进行方向重合比对。从机构信息缺失的情况看，本批次更偏向高校与垂直领域团队的成果，尚不能判断大厂在VLA/世界模型方向上的方法与竞争关系。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注的三个信号：一是VLA动作生成出现明显技术路线转变，ODEAction用连续ODE替代分块预测、SURE引入时空不确定性，说明“动作表示”正被重新定义；二是基准类论文密集（空间信念、AnimWeb代码生成、浅水UAV零样本），领域进入评测驱动阶段；“通用模型免示教直接充当操作策略”的论断若被复现验证，将冲击现有机器人数据采集与微调范式；此外Agentic编排开始进入FDA工具目录等受监管场景，落地边界在向外扩。
